newsitem.title: USA: United Auto ends Ford buys, buys GM dealers.
newsitem.headline: United Auto ends Ford buys, buys GM dealers.

text.p: United Auto Group Inc said Wednesday it does not expect to complete the acquisition of three Ford Motor Co dealerships in the Chattanooga and Atlanta-area markets.

"We determined that ultimately this acquisition would not have maximized shareholder value," the company said in a statement, adding that it expects to pursue the acquisition of other Ford dealerships.
Aggregate consideration for the acquisition was about $23 million.
Separately, the nation's second largest publicly-traded automotive retailer said it completed acquiring 100 percent of the capital stock of three General Motors Corp dealerships in the Carolinas.
The dealerships, located in Charleston, South Carolina suburbs, had 1996 revenues of about $135 million.
United Auto said aggregate consideration was about $30 million, including about $17 million cash and about $13 million in its common stock.
